hero.title: How many hours a week do you spend on work a computer could do?
hero.subtitle: Process automation, document processing and AI chatbots for small and mid-sized businesses.

items.title: Process automation
items.description: Repetitive tasks get done automatically, so you have time for work that matters.
items.details: Take a look at where the most time goes — retyping data between systems, chasing details over email, or filling out the same form every week. Tasks like these can often be connected so they run on their own in the background: from an order landing in one system to it updating automatically in another, without anyone copying data by hand. Besides saving time, this usually also means fewer mistakes that creep in during repetitive manual work. This fits orders, inventory, invoicing, syncing between spreadsheets and business systems, or anything else you do the same way every week.

items.title: AI document processing
items.description: Invoices, contracts and forms are read and sorted automatically, without manual data entry.
items.details: Invoices, delivery notes, contracts and forms often arrive in different formats — PDF, scanned image, email — and someone has to read them and enter the details by hand. AI can read these documents for you: recognising amounts, dates, line items and parties, and organising them into a format your system understands. That means less manual entry and less room for typos when copying data across. This fits incoming invoices, purchase orders, contracts, or any documents someone currently reviews and retypes by hand.

items.title: AI chatbots for businesses
items.description: Visitors get an answer right away, even outside office hours, and you have fewer routine questions.
items.details: A website visitor often leaves if they can't get an answer to a simple question right away — even outside office hours. A chatbot tailored to your services answers common questions, helps visitors find the right information, and points them toward booking or contact when it makes sense. You get fewer routine questions by email and phone, and visitors get a faster answer. The bot only knows what you tell it — it won't invent prices or promises you can't keep.

items.title: Website design for businesses
items.description: A clear website that leads visitors to get in touch or book a call.
items.details: Your website is often the first thing a prospective client sees, so it needs to clearly say what you do and where the visitor should click next. I build sites that are fast, easy to read on a phone, and lead the visitor toward one clear goal — an enquiry, a booking, or a call. No unnecessary animation, no text that doesn't say anything concrete. This fits businesses that don't have a website yet, or have an old one that doesn't clearly explain what they offer.

about.title: About me
about.paragraph1: My name is Nejc. I started AZENO after noticing something simple: the tools that could save Slovenian businesses hours every week already exist and are within reach. Nobody just sets them up. Larger agencies chase larger clients, which leaves small and mid-sized companies without anyone willing to sit down with their actual process.
about.paragraph2: So every project starts with your work, not with technology. First I want to understand what someone at your company does by hand, how often, and where it breaks down. Only then does it make sense to talk about a solution. If something isn't worth automating, I'll say so. I'm young, and for this work that's an advantage: I carry no habits about how things have always been done, and I do have the time to go deep on your particular case.

chat.bubbleGreeting: Have a question about automation? Ask me.
chat.firstMessage: Hello! I can tell you about process automation, document processing, chatbots or websites. What are you most interested in?
chat.privacyText: The conversation is sent to the controller by email. Do not enter sensitive personal data.
chat.errorMessage: I can't respond right now, please try again shortly or book a consultation.
chat.interruptedMessage: The answer was interrupted. Please try again or book a consultation.

controller.heading: Controller
controller.body: AZENO, Nejc Glodež. The company is in the process of registration; details will be added. Contact: info@azeno.si.

whatWeCollect.heading: What we collect
items: The content of your conversation with the chatbot, including anything you write yourself.
Your IP address, temporarily, solely to limit the number of requests (protection against abuse).
When booking a consultation: name, email address, company name, area of interest, description of the problem, and time zone.

why.heading: Why
items: So the chatbot can answer questions.
So we can arrange the consultation and prepare for it.
So we can improve the bot's answers.

legalBasis.heading: Legal basis
legalBasis.body: Legitimate interest in responding to inquiries, and taking steps prior to entering into a contract at the individual's request. Processing of the IP address is based on a legitimate interest in preventing abuse and keeping the site running securely.

processors.heading: Who receives the data (processors)
items: OpenAI — processes the conversation content so the bot can respond (servers in the US). They may retain the content in line with their own privacy policy: openai.com/policies/privacy-policy.
Resend — sends the full conversation transcript to the controller by email.
Google — the controller's calendar and email.

retention.heading: How long
retention.body: Conversation transcripts remain in the controller's mailbox until deleted. Bookings remain in the calendar. You can request deletion at any time.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: Access, correction, erasure, restriction of processing, objection, and data portability. Send your request to info@azeno.si. You can file a complaint with the Information Commissioner of the Republic of Slovenia.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.body: This site does not use cookies for tracking or advertising. The chat widget uses sessionStorage in your browser to function, which is cleared when you close the tab.
